hook: Cited answers from 250M+ papers for your literature review 📚
summary: AnswerThis searches 250M+ academic papers and returns cited answers and summaries, with a library that exports to Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote. Pro adds an AI Writer and PRISMA systematic reviews.
points: Free plan, no card: cited search and 5 saved projects
2,000+ citation styles in the AI Writer
Pro $35/mo with agent-led PRISMA systematic reviews
caveat: AI summaries still need checking against the original papers before you cite them.
